newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended slightly lower, with some downward pressure on prices attributed to new issues.
Following Italy's one billion Swiss franc seven-year bond Tuesday, Deutsche Bank also issued a 500 million Swiss franc bond on Thursday.

The spread to German Bunds continued to narrow, with 10-year Federal bond yields now 234 basis points apart. Swiss short-term prices also fell sharply, with three-month EuroSwiss futures on ending down nine basis points at 98.55. The Swiss National Bank, as expected, left its discount rate unchanged at Thursday's meeting as the franc continued to weaken.
Conf futures CONFc1 down one at 120.87.
Comi medium-term bond COMIc1 down 35 at 111.90
Euro Swiss francs FESc1 down nine at 98.55.
